forks.description: Number of children to fork and watch. Default is 1.

retries.description: Number of retries to fork a single child. Default is 3.

timeout_ms.description: Retry timeout in milliseconds. If the child dies after this timeout, the retry counter is reset. Default is 10000 ms (10s).

signal.description: Signal to send to children to signal 'graceful' termination (HUP, INT, QUIT, TERM, USR1, USR2). Default is USR1.

command_args.description: Arguments for the application executable. Items: flat map of argument strings.
